system.boundary: Build a Simulink/Simscape longitudinal model of a power-split hybrid-electric passenger vehicle.
engineering_objects: Build a Simulink/Simscape longitudinal model of a power-split hybrid-electric passenger vehicle.

The physical drivetrain shall include an internal-combustion engine, two motor-generator units, a planetary power-split mechanism, a high-voltage battery with a DC/DC power path, and a driven vehicle/load.
These elements must be connected by real mechanical and electrical power paths rather than by prescribed output signals.
physical_paths: The physical drivetrain shall include an internal-combustion engine, two motor-generator units, a planetary power-split mechanism, a high-voltage battery with a DC/DC power path, and a driven vehicle/load.
These elements must be connected by real mechanical and electrical power paths rather than by prescribed output signals.
The system shall remain functional for speed references from standstill through 110 km/h, road grades from -5% through +3%, and initial battery state of charge from 50% through 70%.
Build a Simulink/Simscape longitudinal model of a power-split hybrid-electric passenger vehicle.
functional_paths: Implement closed-loop vehicle-speed tracking from a measured vehicle-speed signal and a time-varying speed reference.
All logs must be measurements or commands from the implemented vehicle and controller, not prescribed result waveforms.
